selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall/forwarding on node1 permits only necessary traffic and routes tunnel to private LAN
selected_evidence.summary: Committed default-drop input/forward filters with explicit allow rules for SSH, WireGuard UDP, established/related, and wg0->eth1 forwarding; ip_forward and per-interface forwarding confirmed enabled

selected_evidence.requirement: Return routing for tunnel traffic on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Added static route 10.200.0.0/24 via node1 private IP on node2; end-to-end ping from node3 to node2 private IP succeeded

selected_evidence.requirement: App served on node2 TCP 8080, scoped to private network only
selected_evidence.summary: systemd-managed python3 http.server bound to 10.50.50.11:8080; firewalld zone 'private-app' restricts port 8080 to enp8s0 only

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 reaches the app only through the WireGuard tunnel (not directly)
selected_evidence.summary: curl succeeds via wg0 route while tunnel is up; stopping wg-quick causes the kernel route to fall back to the public gateway and curl fails (falsifying test); restoring the tunnel restores access
